blocks.text: בְּקוֹל סַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר: לְיוֹדְעָיו יוּשַׁב. לְאוֹת טוֹב יִתְחַשֵּׁב. לְעֵת יִתְיַשֵּׁב. בְּקוֹל טַעַם שׁוֹפָר: מוֹאֲסָיו לְהַבְקִיעַ. בּוֹגְדָיו לְקַעְקֵעַ. מוֹרְדָיו לְהַשְׁקִיעַ. בְּקוֹל חִזּוּק שׁוֹפָר: מַאֲרִיךְ בְּהִתָּקֵעַ. מְקַצֵּר בְּהִבָּקֵעַ. מֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ. בְּקוֹל שִׁלּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵן אֵימוֹת. מַחְפִּיז אֻמּוֹת. נוּסוּ נוֹאֲמוֹת. מִקּוֹל בּוֹךְ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵץ חוֹמוֹת. מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת. נוֹהֵם כַּהֲמוֹת. קוֹל שַׁאַג שׁוֹפָר: סוֹדוֹ כְּגִלָּה. בְּסִין לְסֶגֻלָּה. סִים מְגִלָּה. בְּקוֹל הִלּוּךְ שׁוֹפָר: סוֹד יוֹם גְּאֻלָּה. בְּחָסְפּוֹ לִדְגוּלָה. שָׂשׂוֹן וְגִילָה. קוֹל יַשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹפָר: עָשׂוֹר דּוֹחֶה. עֹנֶג מַדְחֶה. עֲבֵרוֹת מְמַחֶה.

blocks.text: through the stormy sound of the Shofar. For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar. They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar. It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar. It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar. It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar. When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar. When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar. On the tenth of Tishri was it sounded, even on the day of the Sabbath rest, sins were obliterated through the ringing sound of the
Truly He will bear me as a seal on the heart as once when beneath the apple tree He roused me with His voice.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’.
Thou hast raised me, O God, over all daughters since on my behalf on Horeb didst Thou give voice. Over all gods art Thou greatly exalted, to eternity shalt Thou be exalted with the Teruah’s voice.
As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the Lord with a Shofar sound’. And it is said: ‘With trumpets and a Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’.

A bird from Egypt (Israel) cooed from the wilderness and a dove from Assyria sounded its voice. Take note of the bird of Thy household, seek out the patient dove, blow the Shofar for them and whistle to them with Thy voice.
